prompt: Some people think that high salary is important when choosing a company to work for, while other think that good working atmosphere is more important, Discuss both views and state your opinion.
essay:
It is often debated whether people should prioritise a high salary or a positive working environment when choosing a company. Although a healthy workplace can enhance productivity and encourage employees to remain with the same employer, I believe that a high income is more important because it provides financial security and a better quality of life.

On the one hand, a positive working environment can have a significant impact on employees’ performance and job satisfaction. When workers feel supported, respected and comfortable, they are more likely to perform effectively and continue developing their skills and abilities. Moreover, a healthy atmosphere can encourage employees to stay with the same company for longer, as they are less likely to experience stress or consider resigning. For example, many employees in the UK banking sector reportedly leave their jobs after relatively short periods because of high levels of stress and unhealthy workplace cultures, despite receiving competitive salaries. Therefore, a supportive environment can contribute to both professional development and employee retention.

On the other hand, I believe that financial compensation is more important because it affects people’s lives beyond the workplace. As the cost of living continues to rise, a well-paid job enables individuals to cover essential expenses, such as housing, groceries and their children’s education, without excessive financial pressure. It can also provide opportunities to enjoy life through travel and leisure, while allowing people to save for their future and retirement. For instance, in Saudi Arabia, employees with higher salaries generally receive higher pension payments after retirement. This demonstrates that greater earnings can provide financial benefits that extend beyond an individual’s working years.

In conclusion, although a positive working environment can improve employees’ performance, development and long-term commitment, I believe that a high salary is more important. This is because financial security influences not only people’s working lives but also their ability to maintain a comfortable lifestyle and prepare for the future.
